title: Hypothesis Evaluation Event
description: A directed, typed belief-update event testing an existing hypothesis (target_hypothesis_id) against reproducible measurements, primary-source collisions, cross-session audits, or boundary thought experiments. Used by tools/belief_state.py to compute posterior hypothesis distributions P_t(H|Q), epistemic uncertainty, and mass transfer from refuted/narrowed parents to scoped child hypotheses.

evaluation_id.description: Collision-resistant ID minted via tools/new_id.py EVL (EVL-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxx).

compared_against_hypothesis_ids.description: Competing hypotheses tested alongside target_hypothesis_id to prevent single-hypothesis confirmation bias.

spawned_hypothesis_ids.description: Scoped or synthesized child hypotheses receiving probability mass when verdict is narrows_scope, refutes_unconditioned, or subsumes.

script_command.description: Optional reproducible command verifying a measured verdict.

no_recompute_reason.description: Why a number in this row's summary is neither recomputable by script_command nor traceable to a verified material (2026-11-20, ④). Required from 2026-11-21 when the summary asserts a number and neither of the other two routes is present: every number must be recomputed, traced to a checked text, or explained.

scope_inherited_by_hypothesis_ids.description: Hypotheses that inherit the remaining scope when this row narrows or refutes the target (2026-11-16, P-5). Until now such a parent had to be named in spawned_hypothesis_ids, a field whose name means 'created'; the engine pays it +0.75*delta on narrows_scope and +0.95*delta on refutes_unconditioned, exactly as it does for spawned. Naming the operation here leaves the arithmetic identical and the record readable.

agency_stance.description: Required from 2026-11-21 for new evaluations: the evaluator's agential stance toward this judgment. 'endorse' = I subjectively take on this evaluation; 'report_only' = I report the opposition but endorse neither side yet; 'dissent' = I subjectively oppose the target hypothesis; 'self_correction' = I am correcting my own past judgment. This is a structural judgment-of-agency tag (Synofzik et al. 2008), not a claim about phenomenal consciousness.
